label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter flows directly to response.getWriter().write() without complete sanitization. The replace() call only modifies the last character (index param.length()-1 to param.length()), leaving all preceding characters including potential XSS payloads like script tags unescaped. X-XSS-Protection header is explicitly disabled to '0', confirming intent to allow execution.

evidence.note: User parameter retrieved from request and conditionally sanitized by replacing only the last character with Z
